purpose: Evidence log for current six-entry registry; not a scholarly authentication or approval record.
method: Compared registry references and excerpts with the linked public Quran.com and Sunnah.com pages. This is a limited web-source comparison, not review of printed critical editions, chains, full context, translation licensing, or scholarly interpretation.

status_definitions.reference_checked: Reference locator was found on a cited page; does not establish all scholarly questions.
status_definitions.original_text_checked: Only the displayed excerpt was compared. Orthographic, edition, and contextual checks remain separate.
status_definitions.translation_checked: Whether the current Indonesian string is an exact published translation or only a summary.
status_definitions.authenticity_reviewed: For hadith, whether an independent qualified authenticity review is documented.
status_definitions.scholarly_interpretation_reviewed: Whether qualified human review of interpretation/context is documented.
status_definitions.qualified_human_approval_documented: Whether a named, qualified human approval record exists in repository evidence.

sources.registry_arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
sources.text_form: partial Arabic excerpt from a longer hadith
sources.registry_indonesian_text: Barang siapa beriman kepada Allah dan hari akhir, hendaklah berkata baik atau diam.

primary_sources_checked.publication: Sunnah.com, Sahih Muslim 47b as displayed on the page

sources.locator_and_numbering: Bukhari 6018 (Book 78, Hadith 49 on page); Muslim page identifies 47b and also shows in-book Book 1, Hadith 81. Numbering schemes differ.
sources.edition_translator_publisher: Online Arabic/English display checked; no printed edition or Indonesian hadith translator established.
sources.evidence: Both pages display the phrase about speaking good or remaining silent as part of a longer narration; Bukhari page explicitly shows modern reference 6018 and an older deprecated numbering scheme.
discrepancies: Registry locator 'Muslim 47' is underspecified compared with page's 'Sahih Muslim 47b'; preserve until numbering convention is documented.

sources.text_form: short Arabic excerpt from a longer hadith
sources.registry_indonesian_text: Sesungguhnya amal-amal itu bergantung pada niatnya.
sources.locator_and_numbering: Bukhari 1 (Book 1, Hadith 1 on page); Muslim 1907a / Book 33, Hadith 222 on page. The Muslim page also shows 1907b as a separate transmission.
sources.edition_translator_publisher: Online Arabic/English display checked; no printed edition or Indonesian hadith translator established.
sources.evidence: Bukhari 1 displays إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ. The Sunnah.com Muslim 1907a display uses إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ (singular) in the visible text.
discrepancies: Arabic wording differs between the registry's plural 'بالنيات' and the Muslim 1907a page's singular 'بالنية'. The registry wording matches the displayed Bukhari excerpt; do not imply that the exact same Arabic string was verified for both collections.
